claude_proposed_widenings.name: AnchoredSignal.transport
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The portal transports any creature that enters it to the destination permanent teleportation circle. AnchoredSignal in types.ts only has audible | mental variants. The v4 atom transport_exile already exists in the taxonomy — this is a surface gap, not an atom gap. A transport variant is needed to represent portal passage to a named permanent circle chosen at cast time.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Any creature that enters the portal instantly appears within 5 feet of the destination circle or in the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: AnchorTarget.area.shape.circle
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The portal anchor is a 5-foot-radius circle drawn on the ground. AnchorTarget.area currently only supports a cube shape (used by Alarm). A circle (radius) shape is needed. Note: Attachment.area already supports sphere/radius — the gap is specific to AnchorTarget.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you draw a 5-foot-radius circle on the ground inscribed with sigils

claude_proposed_widenings.name: AnchoredSignal.transport.destination
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The transport destination must be a known permanent teleportation circle identified by sigil sequence, on the same plane of existence. This is a cast-time choice from a player-known registry. No existing surface type can represent a named-permanent-circle destination reference. A destination sub-shape with kind: 'permanent_teleportation_circle' and a chosenAtCast marker is needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: a permanent teleportation circle of your choice whose sigil sequence you know and that is on the same plane of existence as you

discrepancies: no content/teleportation_circle.json authored; accepted self-report-only widening path
